name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
A much clearer guided tour: it walks you through every screen and feature - the dashboard (balance, overdue, credit days, next reminder, batch, Send now), each customer's page, reminders and batches, payments into Tally, analytics, the phone app and the WhatsApp assistant - highlighting exactly what it is explaining. It also sets you up in order (WhatsApp, then UPI, then reminders) and no longer gets stuck going back.
Full non-Tally accounts: create a customer, add bills by date, record payments with a payment log, edit or delete entries, and delete a party cleanly.
Add or fix a customer's WhatsApp number right inside ASVA. Faster app updates.
